title: Income-tax depreciation: half rate, additional depreciation, caps and the laboratory-technology rate
description: The percentages that section 33(4) and (9) of the Income-tax Act, 2025 and rule 25(2) and (7) of the Income-tax Rules, 2026 apply beside the Table in Appendix I, for tax years from 2026-27: the half rate for an asset acquired in the tax year and put to use in it for less than 180 days, the additional depreciation on new machinery or plant, the 40% cap on the depreciation of any block of assets of the persons rule 25(2) names, and the 40% rate for new machinery or plant making an article invented in, or by technology developed in, a laboratory of a kind rule 25(7) names, each with its test in the words of its instrument. Who may claim additional depreciation is set by section 33(8), which is not repeated here.

columns.name: days
columns.title: Put to use for less than (days)

instruments: Income-tax Act, 2025 (30 of 2025), section 33(4), (8) and (9), in force 1 April 2026 (section 1(3))
Income-tax Rules, 2026, G.S.R. 198(E), 20 March 2026 (Notification No. 22/2026, F. No. 370142/41/2025-TPL), rule 25(2) and (7), in force 1 April 2026 (rule 1(2))

cells.name: Half rate: an asset acquired in the tax year and put to use in it for less than 180 days
cells.test: The deduction under this section shall be restricted to 50% of the prescribed rate, if such asset, being asset referred to in sub-sections (2) and (3) is–– (a) acquired by the assessee during the tax year; and (b) put to use for the purposes of business or profession for less than one hundred and eighty days in that tax year.

rows.source: Income-tax Act, 2025, section 33(9)(a), read with section 33(8)

cells.name: Additional depreciation on new machinery or plant in the tax year it is acquired and put to use
cells.test: The additional deduction in respect of depreciation referred to in sub-section (8) shall be–– (a) 20% of the actual cost of the new machinery or plant in the tax year when it is acquired and put to use, subject to the provisions of clause (b)

rows.source: Income-tax Act, 2025, section 33(9)(b), read with section 33(8)

cells.name: Additional depreciation: new machinery or plant put to use for less than 180 days in the tax year it is acquired
cells.test: The additional deduction in respect of depreciation referred to in sub-section (8) shall be–– (b) 10% of the actual cost, if the new machinery or plant is acquired and put to use for less than one hundred and eighty days in the relevant tax year, and 10% of the actual cost shall be allowed in the immediately succeeding tax year.

rows.source: Income-tax Act, 2025, section 33(9)(b), read with section 33(8)

cells.name: Additional depreciation: the balance allowed in the next tax year
cells.test: The additional deduction in respect of depreciation referred to in sub-section (8) shall be–– (b) 10% of the actual cost, if the new machinery or plant is acquired and put to use for less than one hundred and eighty days in the relevant tax year, and 10% of the actual cost shall be allowed in the immediately succeeding tax year.

cells.name: Cap on any block: a domestic company that has opted under section 199(3), 200(5) or 201(2)
cells.test: The allowance under section 33(3) in respect of depreciation of any block of assets with respect to the persons mentioned in Column B of the following Table shall not exceed 40% of the written down value of such block of assets, if conditions mentioned in column C thereof are fulfilled:— Domestic company — Which has exercised option under– (a) section 199(3); or (b) section 200(5); or (c) section 201(2).

cells.name: Cap on any block: an individual, Hindu undivided family, association of persons, body of individuals or artificial juridical person whose income is taxed under section 202(1)
cells.test: The allowance under section 33(3) in respect of depreciation of any block of assets with respect to the persons mentioned in Column B of the following Table shall not exceed 40% of the written down value of such block of assets, if conditions mentioned in column C thereof are fulfilled:— (a) Individual or Hindu undivided family; or (b) association of persons or a body of individuals, whether incorporated or not; or (c) artificial juridical person referred to in section 2(77)(g). — Whose income is chargeable to tax under section 202(1).

cells.name: Cap on any block: a co-operative society resident in India that has opted under section 203(5) or 204(2)
cells.test: The allowance under section 33(3) in respect of depreciation of any block of assets with respect to the persons mentioned in Column B of the following Table shall not exceed 40% of the written down value of such block of assets, if conditions mentioned in column C thereof are fulfilled:— Cooperative society resident in India — Which has exercised option under– (a) section 203(5); or (b) section 204(2).

cells.name: New machinery or plant making an article invented in, or by technology developed in, a laboratory of the Government, a public sector company, a university or a recognised institution
cells.test: Where any new machinery or plant is installed during the tax year commencing on or after the 1st April, 1987, for the purposes of business of manufacture or production of any article or thing and such article or thing— (a) is manufactured or produced by using any technology (including any process) or other know- how developed in; or (b) is an article or thing invented in, a laboratory owned or financed by the Government or a laboratory owned by a public sector company or a University or an institution recognised in this behalf by the Secretary, Department of Scientific and Industrial Research, Government of India, such plant or machinery shall be treated as a part of block of assets qualifying for depreciation at the rate of 40% of written down value, if the following conditions are fulfilled:— (i) the right to use such technology (including any process) or other know- how or to manufacture or produce such article or thing has been acquired from the owner of such laboratory or any person deriving title from such owner; (ii) the return furnished by the assessee for his income, or the income of any other person in respect of which he is assessable, for any tax year in which the said machinery or plant is acquired, shall be accompanied by a certificate from the Secretary, Department of Scientific and Industrial Research, Government of India, to the effect that such article or thing is manufactured or produced by using such technology (including any process) or other know-how developed in such laboratory or is an article or thing invented in such laboratory ; and (iii) the machinery or plant is not used for the purpose of business of manufacture or production of any article or thing specified in the list in the Schedule XIII to the Act.
